basic_info.description: Fabulous remodeled home offers abundant natural light, windows on 4 sides, contemporary spaces w/clean lines and stylish modern finishes. Main level features open living rm, dining rm and kitchen w/2 sets of patio doors opening to lush, private garden w/brick patios. Kitchen is appointed w/handsome stone counter tops and a large center island w/bar seating. This level has 3 bedrooms including the smaller BR which is perfect as office or nursery. Master BR w/bay window, 2 closets and en-suite bath w/dble sinks, limestone topped vanity. Bathroom is spacious and offers a 2nd entrance from main hallway. Lower level features a comfortable 4th bedroom and bath. Bamboo floors, recessed lighting, lrg storage rm, attic w/pull-down ladder, 1-car garage.
